seo.description: Visit Kasbah Taourirt in Ouarzazate: former Glaoui stronghold with courtyards, rooms and views over the town.
seo.keywords: Kasbah Taourirt, Ouarzazate kasbah, Glaoui kasbah

name: Kasbah Taourirt
hero_subtitle: Former Glaoui stronghold at the edge of town — courtyards, lanes and desert-gateway atmosphere.

overview.title: The kasbah that watched the caravan routes
overview.p1: Kasbah Taourirt once belonged to the powerful Glaoui family and still dominates the approach to Ouarzazate. Inside, a maze of rooms, courtyards and terraces shows how a desert-edge stronghold worked.
overview.p2: It is one of the easiest kasbahs to visit from the centre. Pair it with Atlas Studios or a drive toward Aït Benhaddou the same day.

1.title: Cooler lanes

2.title: Midday heat
2.desc: Indoor rooms help; outdoor terraces are intense — carry water.

3.title: Golden mud brick
3.desc: Late light softens the ochre walls — classic Ouarzazate photos.

food.title: Eat near Taourirt
food.p1: Cafés and simple restaurants sit along the approach road and in town. Expect tagines and tourist-oriented menus.
food.p2: Treat the kasbah as the visit; eat before or after in town.
food.li2: Town-centre restaurants a short taxi away.
food.li5: Fuller dinners back in central Ouarzazate.

1.title: Tickets

2.title: Footwear

q1.question: How long at Kasbah Taourirt?
q1.answer: One to two hours covers the main circuits.

q2.question: Is a guide useful?
q2.answer: Optional — a local guide adds Glaoui-era context.

q3.question: Far from the centre?
q3.answer: Short taxi or a longer walk depending on your hotel.

q4.question: Best time of day?
q4.answer: Morning for cooler exploration; late afternoon for exterior light.

q5.question: Combine with Aït Benhaddou?
q5.answer: Yes — a common full-day pairing from Ouarzazate.
